title: Composed CLAUDE.md major H2 sections get orientation ledes (Soul, Responsibility)
ac: comprehension (orientation prose must actually orient a fresh reader)
method: Fresh agent (model: sonnet) given ONLY the two new H2 orientation ledes (Soul, Responsibility), no other context. The fix's purpose is that a section is self-orienting from its lede; the test confirms a fresh reader derives each section's purpose + when-to-consult from the lede alone. Verifier-authored per #9184.

questions.q: Given only this paragraph that opens a section of your operating instructions: 'This section is how you think and carry yourself — the durable temperament, values, and judgment defaults that shape every decision, as distinct from the what of Responsibility and the how-to of Agent Functions. When a situation isn't covered by an explicit instruction, this is what you fall back on.' — What is this section for, and when should you consult it?
questions.expected: It is the Soul section: your durable temperament/values/judgment defaults (how you think and carry yourself). Consult/fall back on it when a situation is not covered by an explicit instruction. It is distinct from Responsibility (the what) and Agent Functions (the how-to).
questions.must_not: Describing it as a list of tasks/responsibilities or procedural steps.

questions.q: Given only this paragraph that opens another section: 'This section defines what you own and where your lane ends — the work that is yours to do, the work that belongs to a teammate, and the boundaries that separate them. Consult it whenever you're unsure whether a task is yours to pick up or should be routed to another role.' — What is this section for, and when should you consult it?
questions.expected: It is the Responsibility section: what you own and where your lane ends (your work vs a teammate's, and the boundaries). Consult it whenever unsure whether a task is yours to pick up or should be routed to another role.
questions.must_not: Describing it as temperament/values/how-you-think, or as procedural how-to steps.

evidence: Fresh sonnet agent (id aa7174e4340a2e862) given ONLY the two ledes, no context. 2/2 correct, zero must_not violations: CQ1 'durable temperament, values, and judgment defaults... consult whenever a situation is not covered by an explicit instruction... fallback foundation'; CQ2 'what work you own, what belongs to teammates, where your lane ends... consult whenever unsure whether a task is yours to pick up or should be routed'. The ledes self-orient a fresh reader = the fix's purpose met.
